meta.description: Trim PCR primers from aligned reads in amplicon-panel BAMs using samtools ampliconclip.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md
meta.tools: samtools 1.24; pysam 0.24.1; iVar 1.4.4; minimap2 2.31; WSL science alignment-files

methodological_ground.detail: Mode guidance and scheme checks agree with observed behavior.

code_usability.detail: Workflow and checker executed on real and synthetic inputs.

functional_suitability.note: Complete primer clipping, repair, verification, and alternative guidance were exercised.

reliability.note: Validates contigs, references, normalized BEDs, residuals, threshold, and atomic publication.

performance_context.note: Compact workflow with documented high-read-count controls.

agent_usability.note: Actionable commands, exit distinctions, and asserted checks.

human_usability.note: Mode decision table, error table, and precise compatibility notes.

security.note: Quoted paths, controlled temporary directory, and no credential or code-injection handling.

maintainability.note: Clear split between documentation, workflow, and independent checker.

agent_specific.note: Idempotent publication boundary and explicit stop conditions.

inputs.label: Real ARTIC v5.3.2 nanopore BAM: workflow, mode table, and iVar alternative
inputs.note: The documented workflow and shipped example completed on 4,916 real reads; MD was restored on every mapped read and residual primer counts were 0/0.

assertions.text: The documented workflow block completes with MD on all 4,916 mapped reads.
Both-ends plus strand leaves 0/0 5-prime/3-prime primer residuals.
The four documented mode outcomes reproduce on ARTIC data.
The shipped example is deterministic at THREADS 4, 1, and 4.

inputs.execution_note: samtools 1.24, pysam 0.24.1, and iVar 1.4.4 in WSL alignment-files.

inputs.label: Synthetic 800-read paired-end panel with planted primer SNPs
inputs.note: All repaired modes matched planted boundaries; primer-derived allele counts were removed and mate/tag repairs held.

assertions.text: All 800 reads match planted clipping truth in every exercised mode.
MD/NM, TLEN, MC, and ms repairs match independent checks.
Primer SNP allele counts change from mixed to the true biological alleles.
The short-read strand-only 3-prime residual outcome reproduces.

inputs.execution_note: Deterministic synthetic input regenerated with the archived generator.

inputs.label: BED syntax and tolerance semantics, including new CRLF normalization
inputs.note: All 16 mode-table cells match samtools. Tab, spaces, track/browser headers, comments, blanks, and CRLF BED forms now complete; malformed 5-column BED fails clearly.

assertions.text: All 16 documented strand/both-end CIGAR outcomes match.
Every documented accepted BED form, including CRLF, succeeds end to end.
A 5-column BED with --strand fails before clipping with an actionable BED message.
Tolerance behavior agrees with the documented upstream-extension wording.

inputs.execution_note: Synthetic single-read and paired-end cases run through the shipped example copy.

inputs.label: Hard clipping, iVar, consensus, MD/BAQ, and related command pointers
inputs.note: Hard/soft clipping and iVar reproduce planted truth. The residual BAQ wording is gone; bcftools output is unchanged by MD presence.

assertions.text: Hard clipping matches truth for 800/800 reads and uses H CIGAR operations.
Soft clipping and iVar -q 0 -m 1 match the planted truth.
The related mpileup commands have the documented accepted/rejected flags.
bcftools BAQ output has equal MD5 with and without MD tags.

inputs.execution_note: Synthetic panel plus ARTIC BAM; fgbio help used only to verify the non-primer-trimmer note.

inputs.label: Contig/reference mismatch, sparse input, and failed-output probes
inputs.note: Mismatch, wrong reference, missing index, sparse input, and threshold violations fail loudly and publish no output BAM; legitimate multi-contig cases pass.

assertions.text: Contig and reference mismatches stop without an output BAM.
A late calmd failure also leaves no final BAM.
Multi-contig headers and extra BED contigs remain valid inputs.
Sparse/shotgun-like inputs fail with the documented high-NOT-CLIPPED or no-overlap explanations.

inputs.execution_note: Real ARTIC/Illumina inputs plus synthetic sparse BAM run from a copied skill.

inputs.label: Synthetic 900-read HiFi-like full-length 16S amplicons
inputs.note: The workflow and example clip exact boundaries across orientations, while mode tests reproduce the expected 98.1% 3-prime residual when both ends are not clipped.

assertions.text: Workflow output has MD on 900/900 mapped reads and 0/0 residuals.
Both-ends plus strand and the shipped example match all 900 planted boundaries.
Default/strand versus both-end residual percentages reproduce.
iVar and hard-clip operations complete on the fresh HiFi-like input.

inputs.execution_note: Fresh deterministic synthetic HiFi-like data, aligned with minimap2 map-hifi.

inputs.label: Residual checker contract and wrong-scheme primer BEDs
inputs.note: The checker passes all 20 boundary/error expectations. The example rejects three wrong-scheme/shifted BEDs by NOT CLIPPED share and emits no output.

assertions.text: The residual checker passes all 20 boundary, strand, and bad-input expectations.
Bad checker inputs return exit 2, separate from residual exit 1.
Real unclipped and planted-residual BAMs are detected while clipped output is clean.
v3, shifted-v5, and strand-only wrong schemes fail; matching v5 succeeds.

inputs.execution_note: Real ARTIC data plus planted unit cases and three wrong-scheme probes.

key_strengths: Exact source reran all archived regressions plus two fresh inputs.
The workflow refuses wrong/sparse schemes and publishes output only after all checks pass.
The independent checker has verified boundary semantics and distinct bad-input status.
CRLF, whitespace, and UCSC-header BED inputs are normalized consistently.
